Extend the check to sub === 'ticket': every positional word (non-flag words; skip the value after --resume, --pr and any other ticket flag that takes a value; read how orchestrator-allow.mjs parses ticket argv to match it) must pass omRunManifestVetted(ctx.root, word). Add an exported helper in tools/om-manifest-guard.mjs if you need one. Keep run/go behavior unchanged.
